action: CNTH-2 LEGAL / COMPLIANCE VALIDATION + PREVIEW READINESS

sources.complianceArea: Online Marketplace / E-Commerce Platform Operator Duties
sources.enactingAuthority: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (NPCSC)
sources.instrumentName: E-Commerce Law of the People's Republic of China (中华人民共和国电子商务法)
sources.technicalImplication: Requires identity verification of equipment providers, intellectual property notice-and-takedown system, joint liability with providers for consumer safety violations, and retention of transaction records.

sources.enactingAuthority: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (NPCSC)
sources.instrumentName: Personal Information Protection Law of the PRC (中华人民共和国个人信息保护法)
sources.technicalImplication: Strict consent mechanics, separate consent for sensitive personal info (ID, biometric, precise geolocation), extraterritorial application (Art. 3), restrictions on cross-border data transfer, and mandatory data subject rights fulfillment.

sources.enactingAuthority: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (NPCSC)
sources.instrumentName: Data Security Law of the People's Republic of China (中华人民共和国数据安全法)
sources.technicalImplication: Hierarchical classification of data (core, important, general), security review for cross-border data transfers, and data security management obligations for cloud operators.

sources.enactingAuthority: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (NPCSC)
sources.instrumentName: Cybersecurity Law of the People's Republic of China (中华人民共和国网络安全法)
sources.technicalImplication: Mandatory real-name registration before granting listing publishing rights (Art. 24); network log retention for at least 6 months (Art. 21); incident reporting.

sources.enactingAuthority: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (NPCSC) / State Council
sources.instrumentName: Law on the Protection of Consumer Rights and Interests & 2024 Implementing Regulations (消费者权益保护法实施条例)
sources.technicalImplication: Ban on automatic contract renewal without explicit consent; prohibition of disguised fee bundling; mandatory transparent display of total rental charges.

sources.instrumentName: Civil Code of the People's Republic of China (Book III: Contracts) (中华人民共和国民法典合同编)
sources.technicalImplication: Standardizes formation of electronic contracts, deposit rules, equipment maintenance allocations between lessor and lessee, and default liabilities.

sources.instrumentName: Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Online Transactions (网络交易监督管理办法)
sources.technicalImplication: Mandatory retention of transaction information for not less than 3 years; prohibition of false reviews or ghost transactions; ranking algorithm disclosure obligations.

sources.instrumentName: Provisions on the Governance of Network Information Content Ecosystem (网络信息内容生态治理规定)
sources.technicalImplication: Strict automated and human pre-moderation required for user-generated listings, gear descriptions, images, and communications.

sources.complianceArea: Digital Platform Service Business Notification & Transparency
sources.instrumentName: Royal Decree on the Operation of Digital Platform Service Businesses That Are Subject to Prior Notification B.E. 2565 (2022)
sources.technicalImplication: Mandatory statutory notification to ETDA before operating an online rental marketplace targeting Thailand; annual operational report filing; terms and conditions transparency.
Lawful basis/consent for collecting renter and provider personal data; mandatory privacy policy in clear Thai; data subject rights mechanisms; breach notification within 72 hours.

sources.enactingAuthority: Ministry of Digital Economy and Society / ETDA
sources.instrumentName: Electronic Transactions Act B.E. 2544 (2001) as amended
sources.technicalImplication: Legal recognition of digital rental agreements, electronic records retention, and electronic signature validity.

sources.enactingAuthority: Office of the Consumer Protection Board (OCPB)
sources.instrumentName: Consumer Protection Act B.E. 2522 (1979) as amended
sources.technicalImplication: Prohibition of unfair contract clauses; safety standards for rental equipment; mandatory transparent dispute escalation and refund handling.

sources.enactingAuthority: Office of the Consumer Protection Board (OCPB)
sources.instrumentName: Direct Sales and Direct Marketing Act B.E. 2545 (2002) as amended
sources.technicalImplication: Registration with OCPB for operating online direct marketing / e-commerce platform; consumer cooling-off period disclosures.

sources.complianceArea: Value Added Tax (VAT) on Digital Services (e-Service)
sources.instrumentName: Revenue Code Amendment Act (No. 53) B.E. 2564 (e-Service Tax)
sources.technicalImplication: Mandatory 7% VAT registration for foreign digital platforms with gross revenues from non-VAT registered Thai customers exceeding 1.8M THB per year.
Requires licensed payment gateway for clearing local Baht transactions; strict separation of display currency (THB) from statutory transaction currency (PHP).
